Brand.name: Shadow Platform
Brand.tagline: Disability support services management for universities

Register.title: Register as a New Student
Register.subtitle: Create your account to apply for support services

Unauthorized.title: Access Denied
Unauthorized.message: You don't have permission to view this page. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your system administrator.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: One account for everyone on the platform — what you can see and do is limited to exactly what your role needs, nothing more.
Login.demoAccountsSubtitle: For local testing — click a card to fill in its email (you still need the real password).
Login.demoAccountsFilled: Email filled in — enter the password to continue.
Login.demoStudentDescription: Uploads their own medical and assessment documents and receives files from their lecturers — never sees their own classification or support level.
Login.demoFacultyDescription: Sees students in their own courses and uploads custom files for them — never sees their medical documents or classification.
Login.demoSpecialistDescription: Reviews and classifies documents and approves support plans — for assigned students only.
Login.demoAdminDescription: Manages users and roles, assigns specialists manually, exports CSV, and reads the audit log — never sees a student's classification.

FacultyResources.noResources: No files uploaded for this student yet
FacultyResources.errorLoadingList: Failed to load the file list

auditActions.approve_support_plan: Approved a support plan after classifying a document
auditActions.assign_specialist: Manually assigned a specialist to a student
auditActions.return_request_to_student: Returned a request to the student
auditActions.upload_document: Uploaded a medical or assessment document
auditActions.upload_faculty_resource: Uploaded a custom file for a student
auditActions.view_document_denied: Attempted to open a document without access

AdminUsers.title: Assign a Specialist
AdminUsers.subtitle: Manually link a specialist to a student, and manage users when you need to
AdminUsers.usersListSub: For reference — search by name or email
AdminUsers.hiddenNote: This screen never shows a student's classification or support level — assignment doesn't need it.
AdminUsers.assignSpecialistNote: Assignment here is entirely manual — no student is ever linked to a specialist automatically. A specialist only ever sees students assigned to them.
AdminUsers.errorSelectSpecialistAndStudent: Please choose both a specialist and a student

AdminStats.title: University Statistics
AdminStats.subtitle: A university-wide overview of students and requests
AdminStats.heroDescription: Total students registered in the support system, across every request status.
AdminStats.requestsTableSubtitle: Filter by request status to see who needs attention
AdminStats.hiddenNote: This dashboard only ever shows your own university's data — an administrator at another university can never see your students, and you can never see theirs.

AdminReports.title: Reports
AdminReports.subtitle: Export administrative reports that contain no medical data
AdminReports.studentReportDescription: This report includes: student name (email), request status, registration date, and support plan status only. It does not include classification, support level, assessment notes, or any medical data.

AuditLog.title: Audit Log
AuditLog.subtitle: A complete log of every access attempt to student records — administrators only
AuditLog.readOnlyNote: The log is read-only and nothing is ever deleted from it. Visible to the administrator account only.

FacultyStudents.title: My Students
FacultyStudents.subtitle: Students enrolled in your courses and their approved accommodations only
FacultyStudents.heroDescription: Distinct students across every course you teach.
FacultyStudents.noStudents: No students are currently linked to your courses
FacultyStudents.hiddenNote: You only ever see approved accommodations for your own students — never their medical reports, diagnosis, classification, support level, or specialist notes, and never students outside your own courses.

FacultyUpload.title: Upload for a Student
FacultyUpload.subtitle: Choose a student in one of your courses, then upload a custom file for them.
FacultyUpload.heroTitle: Upload a custom file for a student in your course
FacultyUpload.heroDescription: The file reaches that one student only, and the upload is logged under your name.
FacultyUpload.noCourseLinks: You have no students linked to your courses yet.
FacultyUpload.hiddenNote: You cannot see a student's medical documents or classification, and you cannot upload for a student outside your own courses.

SpecialistQueue.title: Review Queue
SpecialistQueue.subtitle: Students referred to you by the system administrator
SpecialistQueue.heroDescription: Assigned students with an open alert or no assessment yet.
SpecialistQueue.noStudents: No students have been referred to you yet
SpecialistQueue.noStudentsForFilter: No students at this support level
SpecialistQueue.hiddenNote: You only ever see students an administrator has explicitly assigned to you — never the university's full student roster.

SpecialistAlerts.title: Follow-up Alerts
SpecialistAlerts.subtitle: Alerts generated from app usage patterns among your students

SpecialistAssess.title: Assess Student
SpecialistAssess.errorMissingFields: Please choose a category, sub-condition, and support level

SpecialistPlan.title: Support Plan
SpecialistPlan.cannotCreateYet: A support plan cannot be created before the student has been assessed.
SpecialistPlan.errorReasonTooShort: Please write a reason for the revision of at least 5 characters
SpecialistPlan.toolsLockedNotice: Tools can't be changed after the plan is approved. You can revise the support level below.

SpecialistReview.title: Review Document
SpecialistReview.previewPlaceholder:
Document preview
served from secure storage
SpecialistReview.classifySub: Visible only to you, as the specialist assigned to this student.
SpecialistReview.errorMissingFields: Please choose a category, sub-condition, and support level
SpecialistReview.toolsLockedNotice: Tools can't be changed after the plan is approved. You can revise the support level below.
SpecialistReview.errorReasonTooShort: Please write a reason for the revision of at least 5 characters
SpecialistReview.hiddenNote: This screen — classification and plan approval — is visible only to the specialist assigned to this student.

StudentStatus.title: My Dashboard
StudentStatus.subtitle: Your request status, enabled tools, and every file you've uploaded or received
StudentStatus.heroDescription: This reflects the latest decision on your support request.
StudentStatus.verificationPending: Your account is awaiting verification of your university enrollment by the relevant office.
StudentStatus.noTools: No tools are enabled yet. They will be enabled once your support plan is approved.
StudentStatus.newResourceNotice: Your instructor added a new learning resource in course {course}
StudentStatus.filesTableSubtitle: Documents you uploaded and files your lecturers shared with you
StudentStatus.hiddenNote: You never see your own classification, category, support level, specialist notes, or the contents of your medical reports — anywhere in the app, by design. You only ever see your request status and the tools your approved plan enables.

StudentUpload.title: Upload a Document
StudentUpload.subtitle: PDF only — it goes straight to your assigned specialist, and your lecturer never sees it.
StudentUpload.heroTitle: Upload your medical or assessment document
StudentUpload.heroDescription: It's encrypted immediately and reviewed only by your assigned specialist.
StudentUpload.hiddenNote: Your document goes to your assigned specialist only. Neither you nor your lecturer will ever see the classification or support level that results from the review.
